voice-clone.en: Clone your own voice locally on a Mac (Apple Silicon) with CosyVoice3 and generate Chinese / mixed Chinese-English narration.
voice-clone.zh: 在 Mac 本地复刻你自己的声音，生成中文（及中英混合）配音。

code-cinema.en: Direct and render artistic music videos / short films in code. Analyses your song, then invents a fitting visual style for it; the style library grows with every film.
code-cinema.zh: 用代码导演并渲染有艺术性的 MV 与短片：先分析歌，再原创贴合它的画面风格，风格库随每支片子增长。

skill-refine.en: After you edit any skill, consolidate it: file new rules under the right topic, merge duplicates, resolve contradictions, keep SKILL.md lean. Ships a read-only linter and an optional reminder hook.
skill-refine.zh: 每次改完 skill 自动做一遍精炼：新规则归到对的主题、合并重复、消除前后冲突、控制篇幅；附只读体检脚本和可选的提醒钩子。

novel.en: Write web serials at million-character scale, chapter by chapter, without losing the thread: layered context loading, continuity log, character state, foreshadowing tracker, beat sheet, and a post-chapter checklist. Tuned for Fanqie Novel.
novel.zh: 百万字级长篇网文逐章续写不丢线：分层加载上下文、连贯性日志、角色状态、伏笔追踪、节拍表和写后校验清单；按番茄小说平台的规则调校。

apple-app-localization.en: Localize Apple-platform apps with Xcode String Catalogs: migrate legacy .strings, plurals, generated symbols, translate and review against the OS's own terminology, locale QA.
apple-app-localization.zh: 用 Xcode String Catalog 给苹果平台 app 做国际化与翻译：迁移旧 .strings、复数、生成符号，按系统自身译名翻译并复核，多语言验收。

ship-macos-apps.en: Develop and ship native macOS apps safely with an AI coding agent: Debug/Release identity separation, signing, TCC permissions, menu bar items, TestFlight and App Review gates.
ship-macos-apps.zh: 和 AI 编程 agent 一起安全地开发、发布 macOS 原生 app：Debug/Release 身份分离、签名、隐私权限、菜单栏图标、TestFlight 与上架检查。

suno-music-producer.en: Write and revise original songs for Suno, outputting ready-to-paste Title, Styles, parameters and Lyrics.
suno-music-producer.zh: 为 Suno 创作和修改原创歌曲，直接输出可粘贴的 Title、Styles、参数和 Lyrics。

wechat-article.en: Plan, research and write WeChat Official Account articles that read like a person wrote them: topic card, evidence, titles, cutting, quality gates; hands off to wechat-typeset for layout; optional draft upload.
wechat-article.zh: 策划、研究、撰写微信公众号文章，去掉 AI 腔：选题卡、证据、标题与首屏、删稿、发布前质量门；可选推送到草稿箱。

wechat-typeset.en: Typeset a Markdown article for the WeChat Official Account editor in a quiet 'book page' style: whitespace, ink-grey text, one vermilion accent, not a word of the source changed. Ships a renderer, a compliance checker and a copy-to-editor preview.
wechat-typeset.zh: 把 Markdown 母稿排成公众号正文，“书页”风格：留白、墨色、全篇一种朱砂点缀，原文一个字不改；附渲染、合规校验和一键复制的预览页。

chinese-human-editor.en: A final de-AI-voice pass for finished Chinese writing: strip false contrasts, fake aphorisms, tidy parallelism, abstract filler and empty uplift, then check with a script that numbers, quotes, names and links did not drift.
chinese-human-editor.zh: 中文成稿的去 AI 腔终审：清除假转折、假金句、整齐排比、抽象词和万能升华，再用脚本核对数字、引语、专名、链接没有漂移。

project-cleanup.en: Reclaim disk space from a project and the toolchain caches behind it (Xcode, Node, Python, Rust, Gradle, Docker): inventory first, delete what is useless, keep what gets reused, check references, then report. Ships a read-only scanner.
project-cleanup.zh: 清理项目和它背后的工具缓存（Xcode、Node、Python、Rust、Gradle、Docker）：先盘点，没用的删、会复用的留，查清引用再动手，最后报告释放多少；附只读盘点脚本。

zlib-books.en: Find, download and send e-books to a Kindle from the terminal using the zlib CLI: search with quality filters, pick the best edition, download, and email it to Kindle with a bundled script. You must already have your own account.
zlib-books.zh: 用 zlib 命令行搜书、下载电子书并推送到 Kindle：按质量规则挑选最佳版本，附自带的发信脚本；需要你自己的账号。

douyin-interest-card.en: Make Douyin "interest cards" (interactive AI content cards built in Douyin Creator Center's AI Workshop): design the mini-game, write card and landing-page copy, check against the platform's creation rules, generate and fix it in AI Workshop, then publish for review.
douyin-interest-card.zh: 做抖音兴趣卡（在创作者中心 AI工坊 生成的可交互 AI 内容卡）：设计玩法、写卡片和落地页文案、按平台规范自查、在 AI工坊 生成和修改、提交审核。
